recent_en: EWI Capital is progressing the related-party disposal of its Macquarie Park land asset in Australia to Versione Node for AUD32.0 million, with the deadline for conditions precedent extended to 13 December 2026. The company also saw a change in principal officer and released quarterly results for the period ended 31 July 2026.
notable_en: Proposed disposal of 100% equity interest in Eco World (Macquarie) Pty Ltd, which holds a land plot in Macquarie Park, Australia, to Versione Node for AUD32.0 million cash, a related-party transaction.
The deadline for fulfilling conditions precedent for the related-party disposal has been extended to 13 December 2026.
Change in Principal Officer, Mr Leong Chain Hong.
risks_en: The proposed disposal is a related-party transaction; watch the fulfilment of conditions and completion uncertainty.
